methods: solving a quadratic in sin θ
solution:
Using $\cos2\theta=1-2\sin^{2}\theta$:
$$1-2\sin^{2}\theta+\sin\theta=0\quad\Rightarrow\quad 2\sin^{2}\theta-\sin\theta-1=0.$$
Factorising: $(2\sin\theta+1)(\sin\theta-1)=0$.
So $\sin\theta=1$, giving $\theta=\tfrac{\pi}{2}$; or $\sin\theta=-\tfrac12$, giving $\theta=\tfrac{7\pi}{6},\tfrac{11\pi}{6}$.
The solutions are $\theta=\tfrac{\pi}{2},\tfrac{7\pi}{6},\tfrac{11\pi}{6}$.
